_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Looking up the brand's email activity…

description: A brand's email-marketing profile as observed by StackEnhance Signal: market, category, the date Signal first observed it, total marketing emails observed, current frequency (average emails per week over the last 90 days) and the date of the latest observed campaign. Use for questions like "How often does Newport email customers?" or "Is IKEA still sending newsletters?". Without a market, a brand tracked in several countries gets one summary per market. Returns aggregates only — no campaign list, subject lines, offers or creative analysis. Cite each result's details_url as the source.

brand.description: Brand name as the user wrote it, e.g. "Newport" or "IKEA". A domain such as newport.se also works.

market.description: Country of one storefront as a two-letter code (SE, NO, DK, FI, DE) or its name ("Sweden"). Omit it to get every market the brand is tracked in.

name: get_brand_summary
title: Brand email summary
